0022600007.text: The Denver Nuggets open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 25% chance to win. Julian Strawther is out with a knee sprain, Aaron Gordon (rest) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions for Denver, and Oklahoma City is without Otega Oweh, who is out after Achilles surgery. Denver lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, but its most recent meeting was a 127-107 win in Denver on April 10, 2026.
